_notes: All functions in net_chunk_12.c are auto-generated TDR serializer routines from Common/Protocols/PacketCode (TdrBufUtil.cpp and TdrBuf.h). Two families: (1) TdrBufUtil.cpp text/meta dump functions that call FUN_1024a290(buf,tag,ctx,"[fieldName]",fmt,value) and FUN_1010c010(buf,"%s[%u]%c",arrayName,idx,sep) - these are the human-readable 'PrintToText' serializers and authoritatively reveal field name/type/offset/order (debug ToString: low direct server relevance, but they document the exact struct layout the server must (de)serialize on the wire). (2) TdrBuf.h binary pack/unpack functions writing/reading raw sequential fields into a TdrBuf {base,pos,len} 3-int struct - these are the actual compact NoVariant (0x99) wire encoders/decoders (high server relevance). Format-string DAT constants decoded: &DAT_11d9f574="%u"(uint32), &DAT_11d9e0b4="%d"(int32/short), &DAT_11da0cf4="%f"(float), "%I64u"=uint64, "%I64i"=int64, "0x%02x"=uint8, &DAT_11da4eb8=nested-struct opener. No function in this chunk contains a generic tag>>4 dispatch switch; each is a per-struct serializer. Generated TLV docs (docs/, c#_unsafetlvstructures/) use anonymized field_N names keyed to CryGame.dll read stubs at sub_1018xxxx and do NOT contain these named fields/addresses - so no per-field name comparison was possible; the real names below SUPERSEDE the anonymized docs.
